prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent pixel-art character sprite sheet for the existing game 喵喵碰碰大作战.
Input image 1 is the PRIMARY visual reference: the playable swimming characters inside the pool, not its UI, landscape or text. Faithfully match those tiny round, soft, adorable chibi faces, compact silhouettes, broad heads, huge readable eyes, very short upper bodies, small hands resting on the near swim-ring rim and slight elevated front camera. Input image 2 is identity guidance for the three established cats, NOT a request to copy its large standing-body proportions.
Create ONE character only, repeated as THREE equal-size full-body floating sprites in a single horizontal row, in three equal-width cells: LEFT idle/open eyes/tiny smile; MIDDLE impact/eyes squeezed shut/small surprised mouth; RIGHT rebound/happy crescent eyes/open smile. The tiny cat perched on her head changes expression to match. Across all three frames KEEP identical head/ear/hair/body/ring silhouette, camera, ring diameter, center, baseline and scale; only eyes and mouth change. No movement, no rotation, no differently sized frames.
Art: genuine clean detailed pixel art with coherent approximately 96-by-112 logical-pixel structure enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor square pixel clusters. Dark warm 1–2 pixel contours, broad clean color patches, small controlled highlights, cute round faces and clear large eye shapes at small game size. Avoid smooth-vector/anime painting merely with jagged edges, random single-pixel noise, tiny jewelry details and photorealism.
Floating anatomy: an OPEN donut swim ring, a real inflatable annulus, no filled-in seat or bowl floor. Her torso goes through its central opening, her lower body is underwater and therefore absent from the sprite. Rear rim is behind her waist/upper body; both small hands rest on the top of the front rim, front rim occludes her lower torso. She is being held afloat by the ring, never standing, kneeling or sitting on top of a platform. One consistent ring tube thickness front/back, modest ellipse perspective. No visible legs, feet, belly, or buttocks. Tail largely hidden behind her back, never attached to the ring.
Backdrop: TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha throughout empty space and donut opening. No pool water, ripples, wake, cast shadow, checkered background painted into the PNG, background color, UI, words, labels, numbers or watermark. Give every sprite generous transparent padding and leave clear gaps between three non-overlapping cells; no detached decorations. Each sprite including head-top kitten and ring must be entirely within its own cell. Reference image 1's game sprites are the target; do NOT remake the screen.
CHARACTER IDENTITY:
ONLY JUZI / 橘子: Chinese orange tabby cat girl. Bright warm orange short fluffy bob with outward curls and subtle darker tabby hair streaks, orange cat ears with cream interiors, AMBER orange/gold eyes, a small white daisy with orange center and green leaves clipped on the viewer's right. A tiny orange tabby kitten lying atop her head with white muzzle/paws. Tiny cream-and-orange sailor/frill outfit, simple citrus flower clasp. Orange-and-cream alternating orange-slice swim ring. Retain her exact orange identity; do not change hair into braids or eye color to blue.
